People: William Shakespeare (author, Wikidata Q692), died 1616; François Guizot (translator, Wikidata Q157324), died 1874. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Shakespeare, William, 1564-1616; Guizot, François, 1787-1874 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Oeuvres complètes, traduction de m. Guizot. Nouv. éd., entièrement revue avec une étude sur Shakespeare, des notices sur chaque pièce, et des notes, Paris Didier, 1872, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/oeuvrescomplte08shakuoft. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 85%, 87%, 86% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of William Shakespeare, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
